subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A short text written on tombstone
solution:
The correct answer is **"Epitaph"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, the most appropriate answer that can be used as a one-word substitute is **'epitaph.'**
 
• **Epitaph:** a short piece of writing or a poem about a dead person, especially one written on their gravestone.
 
 
• **Example:** *Several **epitaphs** from the past have been preserved in the cathedral.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​__Let's look at the meanings of the other options.
 
• **Celibacy:** The state of not having sex.
 
• **Calligraphy:** Beautiful writing, often created with a special pen or brush.
 
• **Extempore:** done or said without any preparation or thought.
